blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu residents should prepare for rain showers and thunderstorms on Friday, Nov. 20, as the Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ) affects Central Visayas, while the heat index could reach 38 degrees Celsius despite the expected rainfall. The state weather bureau forecast cloudy skies with rain showers and thunderstorms across Central Visayas, Negros Island Region and Eastern Visayas, citing the ITCZ as the weather system influencing these areas.
